name: search-accounts
description: Finds the accounts (companies) saved in your Apollo team by name, sorted and paged. Spends no Apollo credits. Answers each account's id, name, domain, owner id and stage id. Apollo's wider database of companies is apollo__search-companies.

name.description: Account or company name to search for.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort matching accounts.

sortAscending.description: Whether to sort in ascending order.

perPage.description: Maximum accounts to return per page.
